patterns.note: Product cards are presented in a flexible grid that adapts to available space, often with a slight overflow to suggest more content beyond the current viewport.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for strong hierarchy, while body text is much smaller and lighter, creating a clear visual distinction between primary and secondary information.
A stark white background dominates the page, allowing high-quality product photography and subtle brand blue accents for links and calls to action to stand out.
The primary navigation bar at the very top of the page remains fixed as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site navigation while the main content scrolls underneath it.
Sections are introduced with large, centered or left-aligned headings, followed by product grids or informational blocks, maintaining a consistent and clean content structure.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, ensuring it stays at the top of the viewport regardless of scroll depth, allowing for constant access to main site links.
Product displays utilize high-resolution, often isolated, photography against a clean white background to emphasize the product itself, making it the focal point of each section.
Information is presented in digestible blocks, often using a grid layout for product comparisons or accessory showcases, with minimal text and clear calls to action to guide the user.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, modern sans-serif, complemented by small, light body text and even smaller legal disclaimers.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (product images, some interactive elements like buttons and cards).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding around content blocks, creating a sense of openness and premium feel.

standout: The design's standout feature is its extreme minimalism and reliance on exquisite, high-resolution product photography to convey value. The interface itself almost disappears, allowing the products to be the sole focus, creating a premium and aspirational feel without overt luxury cues.
